name: Lot 414 · River Road Arrival
blurb: Recruit families arrive off River Road and park. Have the gameday logistics graphic ready at the entrance.
note: Position derived from LSU 2026 Pregame Traffic Flow map, updated 16 Aug 2026.

name: Board the Charter Bus
blurb: Buses are parked in the lot. Once you park, walk over and board. Staff will point the way.
note: Bus staging position inside Lot 414 to be confirmed.

name: Football Operations Facility
blurb: Arrival point for the visit. Home base before the walk to the stadium.

name: Tiger Tailgate · Indoors
blurb: Indoor tailgate. Walk-On's catering, video games, facility tour, former players.

name: Registration
blurb: Recruit check in. Arrival time is printed on the gameday logistics graphic.
note: Assumed inside the Operations Facility. Exact room to be confirmed.

name: Tiger Walk · Victory Hill
blurb: The team, spirit squad and band come down Victory Hill along North Stadium Drive.
note: Guest drop point for the walk to be confirmed.

name: Lawton Room
blurb: Northwest corner of Tiger Stadium at Gate 7. Staff remarks, halftime meal, open all game.
note: LSU Athletics places the Lawton Room at the corner of North Stadium Dr and West Stadium Dr.

name: Field Level Warmups
blurb: Field level access to watch pregame warmups from behind the designated lines.
note: Access gate or tunnel to be confirmed.

name: Postgame · Nicholson Gateway
blurb: Buses stage in front of Matherne's Market and Torchy's. Walk North Stadium Dr and cross Nicholson.
note: Matherne's Market at LSU and Torchy's sit roughly 350 ft apart in the Nicholson Gateway development.
